sub_graphs.title: EIP-7823: MODEXP Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of input size constraints for the MODEXP precompile

nodes.label: MODEXP Precompile Call Received
nodes.description: A call to the MODEXP precompile (address 0x05) has been received with input data

nodes.label: Parse Length Parameters
nodes.description: Extract length_of_BASE, length_of_EXPONENT, and length_of_MODULUS from input

nodes.label: Length Parameters Parsed
nodes.description: All three length parameters have been extracted from input data

nodes.label: Check BASE Length Limit
nodes.description: Verify length_of_BASE <= 1024 bytes (8192 bits)

nodes.label: Check EXPONENT Length Limit
nodes.description: Verify length_of_EXPONENT <= 1024 bytes (8192 bits)

nodes.label: Check MODULUS Length Limit
nodes.description: Verify length_of_MODULUS <= 1024 bytes (8192 bits)

nodes.label: All Lengths Within Bounds
nodes.description: All three length parameters are within the 1024-byte limit

nodes.label: Length Limit Exceeded
nodes.description: At least one length parameter exceeds the 1024-byte limit

nodes.label: Consume All Available Gas
nodes.description: Precompile consumes all gas provided to the call

nodes.label: Return Error Status
nodes.description: Terminate execution and return error to caller

nodes.label: MODEXP Call Failed
nodes.description: Precompile call has failed due to excessive input length

nodes.label: Proceed with MODEXP Calculation
nodes.description: Continue with standard MODEXP computation (per EIP-198)

nodes.label: MODEXP Calculation in Progress
nodes.description: MODEXP precompile is computing the result

external_entities.name: Contract or EOA Caller
external_entities.description: External entity (contract or transaction) calling the MODEXP precompile

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7823: MODEXP Attack Surface Reduction
sub_graphs.description: Models how input bounds reduce the attack surface and prevent consensus bugs

nodes.label: Pre-EIP7823: Unbounded Input
nodes.description: MODEXP accepts arbitrary input lengths with no upper bound

nodes.label: Post-EIP7823: Bounded Input
nodes.description: MODEXP rejects inputs exceeding 1024-byte limits

nodes.label: Attacker Submits Large Input
nodes.description: Malicious actor attempts to call MODEXP with very large parameters

nodes.label: Large Input Received
nodes.description: Precompile receives input with length > 1024 bytes

nodes.label: Immediate Input Rejection
nodes.description: Input is rejected without complex processing

nodes.label: Attack Vector Closed
nodes.description: Large input attacks are prevented at validation stage

nodes.label: Testing Domain Finite
nodes.description: Bounded inputs create a finite and testable input space

nodes.label: EVMMAX Replacement Feasible
nodes.description: Bounded inputs enable future replacement with EVM code via EVMMAX

external_entities.name: Malicious Actor
external_entities.description: Entity attempting to exploit MODEXP with oversized inputs to cause consensus bugs or resource exhaustion

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7823: MODEXP Gas Behavior on Violation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas consumption behavior when input limits are violated

nodes.label: Gas Allocated to MODEXP Call
nodes.description: Caller has allocated a specific amount of gas for the MODEXP call

nodes.label: Detect Input Violation
nodes.description: Precompile detects that input length exceeds 1024-byte limit

nodes.label: Violation Detected
nodes.description: System has identified an input length violation

nodes.label: Charge All Remaining Gas
nodes.description: Consume entire gas allocation as penalty for violation

nodes.label: Call Gas Exhausted
nodes.description: All gas allocated to the call has been consumed

nodes.label: Caller Economically Penalized
nodes.description: Caller has lost all gas invested in the invalid call

external_entities.name: MODEXP Caller
external_entities.description: Contract or transaction initiating the MODEXP precompile call

ambiguities.text: The specification states precompile 'returns an error status' but does not specify the exact error return format
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard precompile error behavior: return empty data with execution failure status, similar to other precompile failures.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not clarify whether the length check happens before or after gas charging for the MODEXP calculation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume length check happens early (before complex pricing calculation), with all-gas-consumption penalty applied on violation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Historical blockchain analysis accurately represents all legitimate use cases of MODEXP
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The 1024-byte limit could break existing legitimate applications that use larger inputs but were not captured in the historical analysis.

implicit_assumptions.description: No legitimate cryptographic operations require inputs larger than 8192 bits
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Future cryptographic standards requiring larger keys (e.g., post-quantum RSA alternatives) would be unsupported.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations will correctly implement the bounds check identically
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different implementations of the bounds check could lead to consensus failures, the exact problem this EIP aims to prevent.
